Package org.cyborgcats.util

Class Tunable<T>

java.lang.Object
org.cyborgcats.util.Tunable<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the value type, e.g. Double or Boolean
public class Tunable<T> extends Object
A value that is published to and continuously updated from NetworkTables, allowing live adjustment without redeploying robot code.

  • Constructor Details

    • Tunable

      protected Tunable(String name, T defaultValue)
      Creates a tunable with the given default value. Subclasses/factories are responsible for wiring up the NetworkTables topic, subscriber, publisher, and listener for T.
      Parameters:
      name - NetworkTable entry key (under the "Tunable" table)
      defaultValue - initial default value

  • Method Details

    • getValue

      public T getValue()
      Returns the current value, reflecting any updates received from NetworkTables.
      Returns:
      the current value

    • setValue

      public void setValue(T value)
      Sets the current value and republishes it to NetworkTables so other clients (e.g. a dashboard) see the update.
      Parameters:
      value - the new value

    • hasChanged

      public boolean hasChanged()
      Returns true if the value has changed since the last call to this method. Useful for detecting when to re-apply tuned gains or limits to hardware.
      Returns:
      true if the value changed since the previous call
